names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Василиск Сибирский, прп.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the forename. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1824)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 декабря ст. ст. — «Прп. Василиска Сибирского (1824).»

attestations.note: THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind this entry.  The line names one man and he is in this draft. A Cyrillic grep for «Василиск» over every `saint.json` returns `basiliscus-of-amasea`, `cleonicus-of-cappadocia`, `eusignius-of-antioch` and `eutropius-of-cappadocia` — the first another man of the name on another day, the other three prose mentions — and `ls -d saints/basiliscus*` returns two folders, neither of them this man. The day page prints seven hymns — two for Mark the Gravedigger, two for the venerable Marcellus and three for the fourteen thousand infants — and none under this name.
